annotations.title: Tracking links (short links, split tests, postbacks)

description: Short tracking links the brand puts in ads, bios, emails or QR codes. Each click is counted (bots and link previews apart) and sent to one of the link's destinations, picked by weight, so one link also split-tests landing pages. action list (default) | create (name, destinations [{url, weight}], campaign {utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, utm_content, utm_term} added to the page when it has none) | get (linkId: the link, its destinations and its postback URL) | update (linkId + name, destinations, campaign (null clears) or status active / paused; the address never changes) | rotate_postback (linkId: a new postback URL; the old one stops at once) | stats (linkId, from / to as YYYY-MM-DD in UTC or days, up to 92: clicks, bot clicks, clicks per destination, conversions, conversion rate and revenue) | delete (linkId; the address stops working wherever it was printed, so without confirm:true nothing is deleted and the reply says what would stop). The postback URL takes value, currency and txid (a txid is counted once). Destinations must be public web pages. Free.

campaign.description: utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, utm_content, utm_term; null clears

confirm.description: delete: true after the user agreed
